svg.title: 05 | Temporal EEG–Gaze Fusion with GRUs
svg.desc: Executed temporal EEG and gaze sequence modelling on 630 paired 12-second ZuCo 2.0 windows from 18 people, each modality represented as six consecutive two-second bins with four features per bin. Three fixed GRU candidates (gaze-only, EEG-only and gated multimodal fusion) were fitted with Train-only scaling on 371 windows from 11 participants. All were scored on the same 99 Validation windows from three other people. Gated Fusion GRU led temporal Macro F1 at 0.6107, Balanced Accuracy 0.6096 and Accuracy 0.6465, selected at epoch 10. Gaze and EEG GRUs both achieved Macro F1 0.5938, with selected epochs 12 and 3; despite equal pooled metrics their individual predictions differ. Gated fusion does not exceed the strongest classical gaze forest, Macro F1 0.6244. The learned fusion gate is not a causal physiological attribution, and the reserved Test was not scored.

g.text: Six 2-second bins per window | 3 compact GRUs | 99 Validation windows from 3 people
Gating improves on the two temporal unimodal GRUs but not on gaze Random Forest (F1 0.6244).
The temporal gate yields Macro F1 0.6107; the strongest classical gaze-only candidate scores 0.6244.
